guardrail: R_TES is profiled because no independently linked 2024-12-05 IV operating point is available. Fixed-R points are not rejected merely because the inherited nuisance state is unstable; the nuisance optimizer must search for stable candidates. A good profile point shows only that an R_TES operating-point shift can mimic the day-specific low/mid shape under the tested nuisance model. A poor profile does not exclude other untested detector-state differences. No result identifies physical electronics drift.
